title: Liability and Remedy Exclusions
description: Terms that exclude or limit the imposing party's liability for its own wrongdoing, or that exclude the other party's remedies or the imposing party's liability for breach of its obligations.
criteria: Clauses excluding or limiting the imposing party's liability for intentional acts.
Clauses excluding or limiting the imposing party's liability for gross negligence.
Clauses excluding the remedies available to the other party in the case of the imposing party's nonperformance.
Clauses excluding the imposing party's liability in the case of a breach of its own contractual obligations.

title: Presumed Unfair Remedy and Liability Limitations
description: Terms that inappropriately limit the other party's remedies or the imposing party's liability without outright excluding them, or that extend the other party's own liability.
criteria: Clauses inappropriately limiting the remedies available to the other party in the case of the imposing party's nonperformance.
Clauses inappropriately limiting the imposing party's liability in the case of a breach of its obligations.
Clauses extending the liability of the party upon whom the term was unilaterally imposed.

title: Contract Interpretation Discretion
description: Terms reserving to the imposing party sole authority to determine data conformity or to interpret contractual terms.
criteria: Clauses reserving to the imposing party sole authority to determine whether the data supplied conform to the contract.
Clauses reserving to the imposing party sole authority to interpret contractual terms.

title: Customer Data Access Rights
description: Terms establishing the customer right to use generated data.
criteria: Provisions permitting customer access to generated data.
Provisions permitting customer use of generated data.
Provisions securing customer exploitation of data value.

title: Data Copy Retrieval
description: Terms setting timelines for retrieving copies of generated data.
criteria: Provisions governing customer retrieval of data copies during the contract term.
Provisions governing customer retrieval of data copies following contract termination.
Provisions specifying reasonable timeframes for post-termination data collection.

title: Contract Termination Periods
description: Terms governing the customer's ability to terminate the agreement within a reasonable period and restricting the provider from terminating at unreasonably short notice.
criteria: Provisions allowing the customer to terminate the agreement within a reasonable period.
Provisions preventing the provider from terminating the contract at unreasonably short notice.
Provisions accounting for the customer's ability to switch to an alternative service before provider-initiated termination takes effect.
Provisions accounting for the financial detriment caused by provider-initiated termination.

title: Unilateral Contract Modifications
description: Terms specifying provider rights to adjust contractual conditions.
criteria: Provisions specifying valid reasons for unilateral price changes.
Provisions specifying valid reasons for unilateral data specification changes.
Provisions granting customer termination rights upon unilateral modifications.
Provisions requiring advance notice periods for contractual variations.

title: Detrimental Data Exploitation Safeguards
description: Terms restricting detrimental provider exploitation of customer proprietary data.
criteria: Provisions restricting provider access to customer trade secrets.
Provisions restricting provider utilization of customer commercially sensitive data.
Provisions governing protection of customer intellectual property.

title: Contract Termination for Switching
description: Contract terms addressing service termination during customer switching.
criteria: Removal of contractual obstacles to termination.
Notice period conditions for termination.
Termination triggers based on switching completion.

title: Alternative Provider Contracting
description: Contract terms governing customer agreements with competing providers.
criteria: Removal of commercial obstacles to entering new contracts.
Removal of contractual obstacles to entering new contracts.
Permission to engage alternative providers for identical service types.

title: Asset Portability
description: Contract terms facilitating the extraction of assets to external destinations.
criteria: Procedures for porting exportable data.
Procedures for porting digital assets.
Transfer capabilities targeting destination cloud providers.
Transfer capabilities targeting on-premises infrastructure.
Portability entitlements following free-tier service utilization.

title: Functional Equivalence Facilitation
description: Contract terms regarding the maintenance of functional equivalence.
criteria: Removal of technical barriers hindering functional equivalence.
Removal of organizational barriers hindering functional equivalence.
Facilitation of equivalent functionality within destination environments.

title: Service Unbundling
description: Contract terms addressing the operational separation of bundled services.
criteria: Provisions granting separation of distinct service elements.
Technical feasibility conditions governing service decoupling.
Removal of commercial barriers preventing service independence.

title: Contract Availability
description: The contract contains writings regarding pre-signature availability.
criteria: Clauses specifying written terms for switching.
Provisions securing pre-signing accessibility.
Terms enabling customer contract storage.
Terms enabling customer contract reproduction.

title: Switching Assistance Obligations
description: The contract contains writings regarding provider assistance during switching.
criteria: Provisions detailing reasonable assistance to the customer.
Provisions detailing reasonable assistance to authorized third parties.
Obligations regarding continuous business operations maintenance.
Clauses mandating risk disclosure regarding service continuity.
Requirements ensuring data security during transfer.
Provisions supporting the customer exit strategy.

title: Switching Timeframes
description: The contract contains writings regarding transition timelines.
criteria: Clauses specifying a maximum switching notice period capped at two months.
Provisions defining a mandatory maximum transitional period of thirty calendar days.
Terms establishing technical unfeasibility notification within fourteen working days.
Clauses limiting technical alternative transition periods to seven months.
Terms granting a single customer right to extend the transitional period.

title: Data Scope Specifications
description: The contract contains writings defining eligible porting categories.
criteria: Clauses providing an exhaustive specification of portable data categories.
Clauses providing an exhaustive specification of portable digital assets.
Provisions including all exportable data within scope.
Specifications detailing exempted internal provider data categories protecting trade secrets.
Terms ensuring trade secret exemptions do not delay switching.

title: Data Retrieval Period
description: The contract contains writings regarding data retrieval timeframes.
criteria: Clauses defining a minimum data retrieval period of thirty calendar days.
Provisions timing the retrieval period start after transitional period termination.
Terms mandating continued data security during retrieval.

title: Data Erasure Guarantees
description: The contract contains writings governing final data destruction.
criteria: Clauses guaranteeing full erasure of customer-generated exportable data.
Clauses guaranteeing full erasure of directly relating digital assets.
Provisions triggering erasure after retrieval period expiration.
Provisions allowing customer notification requesting data erasure.

title: Contractual Switching Termination
description: The contract contains writings defining contract termination triggers.
criteria: Clauses deeming the contract terminated upon successful switching completion.
Provisions requiring provider notification of switching completion termination.
Terms terminating the contract upon notice period expiration for direct erasure requests.

title: Switching Charges
description: The contract contains writings detailing switching fees.
criteria: Clauses detailing imposed switching charges.
Provisions establishing switching fee compliance conditions.

title: Customer Destination Notifications
description: The contract contains writings regarding destination selection notices.
criteria: Clauses allowing customer notification of switching to an alternative service provider.
Provisions requiring customer submission of destination provider details.
Clauses allowing customer notification of migration to on-premises ICT infrastructure.

title: Inbound Switching Information
description: The documentation contains information regarding switching and porting to the provider, including known restrictions and technical limitations.
criteria: Information on available switching and porting methods.
Information on available switching and porting formats.
Information on restrictions known to the provider that affect switching and porting.
Information on technical limitations known to the provider that affect switching and porting.

title: Exportable Data Online Register
description: The documentation references an online register detailing data export specifications.
criteria: A reference to a provider-hosted online register.
A requirement that the online register remains up-to-date.
Details of available data structures for exportable data.
Details of available data formats for exportable data.
Details of relevant standards for exportable data.
Details of relevant open interoperability specifications for exportable data.

title: Good Faith Switching Cooperation
description: Contractual terms govern mutual good faith cooperation among entities during switching.
criteria: Writings establishing good faith collaboration.
Provisions designating destination provider cooperation obligations.
Measures ensuring the switching process remains effective.

title: Data Transfer Timeliness
description: Contractual terms require prompt execution of data transfer operations.
criteria: Commitments establishing timely data migration.
Specific schedules governing data transfer actions.
Measures preventing data transmission delays.

title: Service Continuity Maintenance
description: Contractual terms protect data processing service continuity throughout switching.
criteria: Provisions safeguarding continuous data processing functionality.
Protocols preventing service disruption during migration.
Requirements maintaining operational stability for the customer.

title: Contractual Transparency Website Listing
description: The contract lists the website(s) publishing the Article 28(1) international-access transparency information for the data processing service(s) it covers.
criteria: A reference to the specific website hosting the required jurisdiction and safeguards disclosures.
The website reference applies to the data processing service(s) governed by this contract.
The reference identifies international-access transparency information specifically, not a generic company or support page.
A commitment that the referenced website's transparency information is kept up to date.

title: ICT Infrastructure Jurisdiction Transparency
description: The documentation discloses the jurisdiction governing the ICT infrastructure used for each data processing service.
criteria: The jurisdiction (country or legal system) governing the ICT infrastructure is named.
Jurisdiction is disclosed per individual service rather than as one blanket statement covering all services.
The disclosed jurisdiction covers the infrastructure actually used for data processing, not merely the provider's corporate domicile.

title: Disclosure of Safeguards Against Foreign Governmental Interception
description: The documentation provides a general description of the technical, organisational, and contractual measures adopted to prevent international governmental access to or transfer of non-personal Union data where this would conflict with Union or Member State law.
criteria: Description of technical measures adopted to prevent unlawful international governmental access to or transfer of non-personal data.
Description of organisational measures adopted for the same purpose.
Description of contractual measures adopted for the same purpose.

title: Switching Charge Cap and Sunset
description: The contract contains writings regarding the amount of switching charges permitted before and after the statutory sunset date.
criteria: Provision stating that no switching charges of any kind are imposed on the customer for the switching process from 12 January 2027 onward.
Provision permitting the provider to impose reduced switching charges for the switching process during the 11 January 2024 to 12 January 2027 transition period.
Provision limiting any transitional switching charges to costs directly incurred by the provider that are directly linked to the switching process concerned.

title: Pre-Contractual Cost Transparency
description: The contract contains writings regarding cost transparency before contract execution.
criteria: Disclosures specifying standard service fees prior to contract conclusion.
Disclosures detailing early termination penalties prior to contract signing.
Disclosures identifying applicable transitional reduced switching charges.

title: Switching Complexity Disclosures
description: The contract contains writings regarding technical impediments to switching.
criteria: Disclosures identifying services involving highly complex switching.
Disclosures identifying services involving costly switching operations.
Disclosures identifying switching scenarios causing significant data interference.
Disclosures identifying switching scenarios causing significant digital asset interference.
Disclosures identifying switching scenarios causing significant service architecture interference.

title: Public Availability of Switching Terms
description: The contract contains writings regarding public access to the fee and switching-complexity information required to be disclosed.
criteria: Provisions committing to publicly disclose the standard fee, termination penalty, and transitional switching charge information.
Provisions committing to publicly disclose the complex, costly, or high-interference switching disclosures.
Provisions specifying that this information is made available via a dedicated website section or another easily accessible means.

title: Infrastructure Switching Support
description: Contractual terms addressing infrastructure provider support duties during switching.
criteria: Provisions on achieving functional equivalence in destination services.
Terms detailing technical capabilities provided to the customer.
Provisions concerning adequate information provided to the customer about the switching process.
Provisions concerning adequate switching documentation.
Commitments to furnish technical support during migration.
Commitments to supply switching tools.

title: Open Interface Availability
description: Contractual clauses governing open interfaces for non-infrastructure services.
criteria: Commitments to provide open interfaces free of charge.
Terms guaranteeing equal interface access for customers.
Terms guaranteeing equal interface access for destination providers.
Inclusion of documentation enabling software communication development.

title: Interoperability Specification Compliance
description: Contractual terms specifying adherence to recognized interoperability benchmarks.
criteria: Commitments to achieve compatibility with common interoperability specifications.
Commitments to achieve compatibility with harmonised interoperability standards.
Adherence to the twelve-month post-publication compliance timeline.
Mandatory updates to the public online register following standards adoption.

title: Data Export Formatting
description: Contractual terms governing data output characteristics during service switching.
criteria: Provisions requiring export of all exportable data upon customer request.
Specifications guaranteeing structured data output.
Specifications guaranteeing commonly used data formats.
Specifications guaranteeing machine-readable data formats.

title: Switching Obligation Limitations
description: Contractual terms defining statutory boundaries to provider switching duties.
criteria: Exclusions regarding the development of novel technologies.
Exclusions regarding the development of novel services.
Safeguards preventing disclosure or transfer of intellectual property-protected digital assets.
Safeguards preventing disclosure or transfer of trade secret-protected digital assets.
Safeguards maintaining the security and integrity of the service.

title: Custom-Built Service Regime
description: Documentation contains writings defining criteria qualifying services for exemption based on individualized development.
criteria: Specifications designating the majority of main features custom-built for an individual customer.
Specifications designating all components developed for the purposes of an individual customer.
Provisions confirming the service is excluded from the broad commercial service catalogue.

title: Testing Service Regime
description: Documentation contains writings defining temporary testing services exempt from switching obligations.
criteria: Designation of services as non-production versions.
Specification of testing purposes.
Specification of evaluation purposes.
Contractual limitation of the operational service timeframe.

title: Pre-Contractual Exemption Disclosure
description: Documentation contains writings informing prospective customers about inapplicable Chapter obligations.
criteria: Disclosures delivered prior to contract conclusion.
For services qualifying under the custom-built regime, disclosure specifies that the obligations in Article 23, point (d), Article 29, and Article 30(1) and (3) do not apply.
For services qualifying under the testing and evaluation regime, disclosure specifies that all obligations of this Chapter do not apply.

title: Preventative Safeguards for International Access
description: The contract contains writings regarding safeguards against conflicting foreign governmental access.
criteria: Implementation of technical measures preventing unlawful foreign governmental access.
Implementation of organisational measures preventing unlawful foreign governmental access.
Contractual restrictions preventing transfers conflicting with Union law.
Contractual restrictions preventing transfers conflicting with Member State law.

title: Verification of Third-Country Access Requests
description: The contract contains writings regarding criteria for evaluating foreign official access requests.
criteria: Verification of applicable international agreements.
Assessment procedures for request proportionality.
Assessment procedures for request specificity.
Verification of judicial review mechanisms in the requesting jurisdiction.
Consultation protocols involving competent national authorities.

title: Data Minimization for Third-Country Disclosures
description: The contract contains writings regarding limits on data quantities provided under foreign requests.
criteria: Commitments to provide the minimum permissible data quantity.
Application of reasonable interpretations to request scope.

title: Customer Notification of Governmental Requests
description: The contract contains writings regarding customer alerts before disclosing data to foreign authorities.
criteria: Mandatory customer notice prior to request fulfillment.
Suspension of notice preserving law enforcement effectiveness.

title: In-Parallel Service Interoperability
description: The contract confirms that the switching-related interoperability obligations under Articles 23, 24, 25(2) and 30(2) to (5) also apply when the data processing service is used in parallel with another provider's service, not only during switching.
criteria: Provisions confirm that customer-facing switching obligations under Articles 23, 24 and 25(2) also apply to support use of the service in parallel with another data processing service, not solely upon contract termination.

Provisions confirm that technical interface obligations — open interfaces and interoperability specifications under Article 30(2) to (5) — apply to enable concurrent operation with another provider's data processing service.
Contract terms address interoperability specifically for ongoing, simultaneous use of multiple data processing services, rather than limiting such terms to the switching or exit process alone.

title: In-Parallel Data Egress Cost Restrictions
description: The contract contains writings regarding data egress fees when the service is used in parallel with another data processing service, limited to passing on the actual costs incurred.
criteria: Provisions confirm that data egress charges may be imposed only in connection with use of the service in parallel with another data processing service.
Provisions limit the purpose of such egress charges to passing on the egress costs actually incurred by the provider, excluding any other charge purpose such as a profit margin.
Provisions cap egress charges so that they do not exceed the actual costs incurred, regardless of the stated purpose of the charge.
